name: John Nelson
bio: John Nelson planned a dairy with Frank Moore in February 1884, but that month the paper reported it was unclear whether he had failed in business, as his goods had disappeared. By late March 1884 J. A. Ferris had opened a dry goods store in the building Nelson had occupied.
